name: Flevy
description:
Flevy is a marketplace of more than 10,000 business documents built by management consultants, many of them former McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, and EY. We also have 8,000+ case studies, covering a diversity of industries and management scenarios.

This connector gives Claude five read-only tools to search and read that library: consulting frameworks and PowerPoint decks, Excel financial models, management case studies, and training guides, organized across hundreds of management topics.

Use it to ground business analysis in proven consulting structure instead of improvising. Pull the right framework for a strategy problem, find a financial model to adapt, look up how a topic like pricing or digital transformation is actually handled, or preview a document slide by slide before opening it. Every result links back to its page on flevy.com.

The tools are free and need no sign-in. The documents themselves are sold on flevy.com; the connector returns descriptions, previews, topic overviews, and ranking signals so you know what a document covers before you buy it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flevy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flevy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://flevy.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Flevy MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Flevy scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flevy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flevy provides these MCP tools: get_content_details, get_slide_deep_dive, get_topic_details, list_topics, and search_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flevy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flevy in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Flevy does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Flevy is developed by Flevy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
